entities.name: ruagent
entities.summary: 本地优先、单用户的智能体工程平台，用 ACP 统一编排多个编码智能体 CLI，并提供统一记忆、知识库与可观测。

entities.name: 用户19410
entities.summary: 中文使用者，Windows 11 + 银河麒麟 V10 arm64 双平台，需离线安装、无 root 权限。

entities.name: AutoHotkey
entities.summary: Windows 键盘/鼠标热键自动化工具，v1 与 v2 语法不兼容；本机为 v2.0.28 解压版。

entities.name: Python 3.10.9
entities.summary: 用户需要在 Windows x64 与麒麟 arm64 上离线部署的目标 Python 版本。

entities.name: 银河麒麟 V10
entities.summary: 国产 Linux 发行版，桌面版基于 Ubuntu 20.04（glibc 2.31），用户机器为 arm64、无 root、无外网。

entities.name: Podman
entities.summary: 用户 Windows 上的容器工具（5.8.1，podman-machine-default），可替代 Docker，机器自带 QEMU。

entities.name: WSL Ubuntu-22.04
entities.summary: 用户 Windows 上的 WSL 发行版，与 podman machine 共享内核，用于 QEMU binfmt 与 chroot 测试。

entities.name: QEMU
entities.summary: 用户态模拟器，配合 binfmt_misc 在 x86_64 上运行 arm64 二进制。

entities.name: python-build-standalone
entities.summary: 提供各平台预编译、可解压即用的 Python 发行版（astral-sh 维护），C 扩展静态链接、glibc 要求低。

entities.name: pandas
entities.summary: Excel 数据处理核心库，依赖 numpy，需选有预编译 wheel 的版本。

entities.name: numpy
entities.summary: 数值计算基础库，离线零编译安装选 1.26.4。

entities.name: openpyxl
entities.summary: 读写 .xlsx 的纯 Python 库，适合离线环境。

entities.name: XlsxWriter
entities.summary: 写 .xlsx 的纯 Python 库。

entities.name: gh-proxy.com
entities.summary: GitHub release 文件加速镜像，间歇可用，不代理网页内容。

entities.name: ghproxy.net
entities.summary: GitHub 加速镜像，与 gh-proxy.com 轮流抽风。

entities.name: 微信
entities.summary: 用户常用即时通讯软件，回车键用于发送消息。

entities.name: Claude Code
entities.summary: Anthropic 的编码智能体 CLI，可作为 ruagent 的执行运行时。

entities.name: Docker
entities.summary: 用户机器上未安装的容器引擎，本想用于断网 arm64 测试。

entities.name: 清华 PyPI 镜像
entities.summary: 国内 PyPI/系统软件镜像源，用于加速下载与 WSL 内 apt。

entities.name: Agent Client Protocol (ACP)
entities.summary: Zed/JetBrains JSON-RPC-over-stdio protocol for client<->agent interop; the standard ruagent builds on.

entities.name: Model Context Protocol (MCP)
entities.summary: Standard tool layer for agents; ACP carries mcpServers config into session/new, and ruagent exposes itself as an MCP server.

entities.name: OpenViking
entities.summary: 字节跳动/火山引擎开源的 Agent 上下文数据库，统一记忆/知识 RAG/Skills，AGPL-3.0

entities.name: Multica
entities.summary: 开源可自部署的 AI 编码 agent 团队工作台，支持 26 个 agent CLI，Apache-2.0 附加条件

entities.name: LoopX
entities.summary: 确定性状态内核/控制面，坐在 harness 之上管理 long-horizon 目标，Apache-2.0

entities.name: Agno
entities.summary: Python 多智能体框架 v3，含六类记忆存储分类法，Apache-2.0

entities.name: DeepSeek Harness (dsh)
entities.summary: DeepSeek's official ACP-native, plugin-based coding harness (npm @deepseek-ai/dsh, MIT); drives ACP via `dsh --profile acp`.

entities.name: OpenCode
entities.summary: 开源编码智能体 CLI，是 ruagent 支持的运行时之一。

entities.name: Ant Design
entities.summary: React 企业级 UI 组件库，ruagent 面板采用的组件层

entities.name: LanceDB
entities.summary: ruagent 知识库使用的向量数据库，构建期依赖 protoc。

entities.name: fastembed
entities.summary: Qdrant 的 Rust ONNX 嵌入推理库，ruagent 本地嵌入方案

entities.name: skills.sh
entities.summary: 可检索和安装的公开 Agent Skill 市场/生态。

entities.name: SKILL.md / Agent Skills
entities.summary: Markdown+frontmatter skill standard (name/description/allowed-tools) with progressive disclosure; fastest-converging cross-CLI artifact.

entities.name: AGENTS.md
entities.summary: Vendor-neutral agent instructions file, one of the two settled standards alongside MCP.

entities.name: Graphiti / Zep
entities.summary: Temporal knowledge-graph memory system; source of bi-temporal edge design (valid_at/invalid_at + created_at/expired_at).

entities.name: HippoRAG
entities.summary: 图谱参与检索的路线：查询→实体定位→邻域子图→定向取块

entities.name: dsh-import-agents
entities.summary: dsh plugin for syncing session history from codex/claude-code/opencode; reference for external history ingestion.

entities.name: Andrej Karpathy
entities.summary: 提出 context engineering 与 LLM OS 隐喻的方法论作者

entities.name: hfldqwe
entities.summary: 用户的 GitHub 账号，ruagent 仓库所有者

entities.name: Vibe Kanban
entities.summary: Kanban board orchestrating many coding-agent CLIs; closest thing to an execution-layer category leader.

entities.name: acpx
entities.summary: Headless CLI client for stateful ACP sessions; a programmatic building block in the ACP ecosystem.

entities.name: DeepSeek Harness
entities.summary: DeepSeek 的编码智能体运行时（dsh），是 ruagent 支持的引擎之一。

entities.summary: 用于把不同编码智能体 CLI 接入统一控制面的客户端协议标准。

entities.name: Model Context Protocol
entities.summary: 智能体工具调用协议，ruagent 以平台 MCP 服务器统一向各引擎暴露记忆与知识工具。

entities.name: Graphiti
entities.summary: Zep 的时序知识图谱引擎，双时间线边设计

entities.name: Postgres 16
entities.summary: PostgreSQL 16, the production database for the project, exposed on port 6543.

entities.name: sqlx
entities.summary: Rust async SQL toolkit and migration tool used to manage the project's migrations.

entities.name: Supabase
entities.summary: Managed Postgres platform whose connection conventions (6543 pooler vs 5432 direct) motivated the review.

entities.name: PgBouncer
entities.summary: Connection pooler whose transaction vs session pool mode determines prepared-statement and advisory-lock behavior.

entities.name: SQLite
entities.summary: Planned queryable store for the project (WAL mode, single-writer actor, group commit).

entities.name: distill
entities.summary: The project whose production database, migration tooling, and storage design are under discussion.
